name: What types of wainscoting styles are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of wainscoting styles are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several popular wainscoting styles can transform a room's aesthetic. Beadboard features vertical grooves and beads, often used in informal settings like kitchens or bathrooms. Raised panel wainscoting offers a classic, formal look with intricate molding. Recessed panel provides a simpler, more contemporary panel style. Picture frame or box panel wainscoting uses trim to create decorative boxes on the wall. Each style can be customized with different heights and finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common wainscoting styles include beadboard, raised panel, recessed panel, and picture frame, each offering a distinct aesthetic.
